comment: She treats this class like a lecture w/ lab; You work on her research, including signing up for times outside of class to do tasks in her lab, which was not what I was looking for, given that it is meant to be a lecture class. It feels similar to bio202 with the plants. Personally, not what I was looking for; My time is carefully allocated.
Dr. Cornell is great. You can tell she cares about how well her students do and that she really enjoys teaching!
